text.p: These are the leading stories in the Albanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
KOHA JONE

- The Socialist Party has threatened to pull out of the coalition government if President Sali Berisha refuses to appoint as head of Intelligence Service (Shik) candidates chosen by Socialist Prime Minister Bashkim Fino.
- The paper alleges that the Democratic Party organised the ambush in the northern town of Shkoder early this month in which Fino and his convoy were held up and forced to return to Tirana.
- Germany fully backs Albania's broad-based government and the OSCE mission to Albania, the German ambassador in Tirana Hanspeter Disdorn said.
- If the referendum rejects a return of the monarchy, then I shall become a citizen of the republic of Albania, exiled king Leka I said in an interview.
- Italian prosecutors in Bari suspect that the Albanian boat which sank with more than 100 people on board after it collided with an Italian vessel last month might have been carrying with guns.
RILINDJA DEMOKRATIKE
- The Democratic Party considers Fino's statement that rebel committees are led by "honest people" as a provocation to the spirit of national reconciliation.
- The Socialist Party has organised a military coup in order to overthrow the democratic government elected through free vote.
GAZETA SHQIPTARE

- The oposition is gathering documents to sue Berisha in the international court in the Hague for genocide against humanity, the paper says, referring to allegations that Berisha ordered the arming of Democratic Party supporters and a crackdown of the rebellion in the south.
- Another group of Albanians is about to illegally cross to Italy from Velipoje, a beach near the northern town of Shkoder.
ALBANIA
- In a clear sign of friendship, French President Jacques Chirac elevated prominent Albanian writer Ismail Kadare to the rank of Officer of the Legion of Honour.
- President Berisha called on experts from the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank to investigate pyramid investment schemes which collapsed early this year.
- New central bank governor Qamil Tusha is quoted as saying he would not accept government measures which might lead to an increase in inflation and in the budget deficit.
ZERI I POPULLIT
- The paper publishes a list of Democratic Party members, including Interior Minister Belul Celo, who were armed on Berisha's orders last month.
- Berisha is an isolated president who does not dare to go out of Tirana to see his people, the paper says.
- Vlore residents urged Berisha to stop calling them "rebels", saying they simply want their money back.
